text:
maya: AM sync — quick async check-in.

maya: What I did: merged kernel scheduler fix (PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/infra/PR/421), ran microbatch bench across r5 & p3 variants; saw ~2.3% tail improvement.

maya: Blockers: KV eviction spike on canary — saw ~15% increase at p99 during sustained 256-token requests, not sure if it's prefetch or eviction threshold.

maya: Today: follow up with perf team, open a small hotfix to adjust cache window, need a quick review on PR 421 and help repro the eviction locally if anyone's free.

kevin: looking now, slight nit in scheduler ordering — added a comment on PR. Can run a repro script later today. ping @tarun for KV traces.

sasha: For eviction, last time we saw this it was when `cache.max_entries` was too low for mixed-seq workloads. Suggest bump from 32k -> 48k and rerun. Small risk of memory but ok on canary.

tarun: I can repro on my local docker stack. Maya — can you drop the failing traces (span IDs) or sample request ids? will try with the same microbatch profile.

maya: sample ids: req-20260317-08-11, req-20260317-08-27. Also attaching the bench snippet:
```
bench/throughput: 1200 req/s
p50: 18ms p95: 52ms p99: 118ms
kv-evict-count: 18 -> spike at t=142s
```

benchbot: benchmark run complete — full CSV: https://bench.redwood/runs/6362. Summary: microbatch=8, slot=4, kernel=optA, median token/s +3.1% vs baseline.

kevin: thx benchbot. @sasha can you try the 48k max_entries change on the canary config? I'll queue the canary rollout after PR is green.

sasha: will do, starting a canary patch now. I’ll post diffs here.

sasha: diff: `cache.max_entries: 32000 -> 48000` `kv.prefetch_window_ms: 30 -> 50`

tarun: reproed the eviction locally with the same sample ids. Looks like prefetch window was too tight — prefetch missed long tails. Increasing window reduced evictions in my run.

maya: awesome. I'll add a short regression test to catch this. Can someone +1 the PR once sasha's canary confirms?

kevin: +1 on review, leaving an approval once CI passes.

ops-bot: deploy canary to cluster-7 started by sasha at 2026-03-17T09:12Z :rocket:

sasha: canary is up, initial telemetry shows eviction count down to 2 in 5m. I'll let it run for 30m then promote.

maya: perfect, thanks. If canary holds, I'll roll the patch to dedicated tomorrow morning. Nothing else from me.

tarun: quick note — I added a tiny repro script in `/dev/repro/kv-evict-small.sh` that others can use. usage: `./kv-evict-small.sh --seed req-20260317-08-11`

kevin: grabbing the script now. thanks.

maya: circle back in a couple hours. :thumbsup:

sasha: update: 30m in, evictions stable, promoting to prod next window.

kevin: great job team.
